The '''Aldo Spachian Comet''' was a [[Comet/Legends|comet]] captured between the two [[Star/Legends|stars]] of the [[Aldo Spachian system]]. The beauty of the comet was legendary and so spectacular that many pilots risked [[Death/Legends|death]] by piloting between the stars in order to approach and observe the comet.<ref name="SL" />
